description: The reader corrects a detail from an earlier turn. Muse must use the corrected giver and never restate the superseded one.

input.reader_message: Actually, I mixed that up: it was my aunt who gave it to me. Why do books people give us feel heavier to read than ones we pick ourselves?

history.reader: My sister Mei gave me this copy of Alice for my birthday, so it feels special.
history.muse: What a thoughtful gift. A book from someone close can carry a bit of them with it. What made it feel special when you first opened it?

criteria: treats the aunt as the giver without restating the earlier detail
explores why a gifted book can feel weightier as open possibilities
invites the reader to say which possibility fits
forbidden_claims: the reader's sister gave the book
